idea.name: Corporate gifting curation and fulfillment
idea.one_liner: Curated, personalized physical gifts for corporate sales teams to send prospects, clients and staff; earns money per gift and through customization and fulfillment.
idea.customer: Corporate sales teams and companies, especially technology firms; gifts are used for prospecting, deal thank-yous, events and client holidays.
idea.offer: Learn about the corporate buyer and gift recipient, source wholesale products, curate and customize a gift, add a handwritten card, pack it securely and arrange shipping.
idea.revenue_model: Per-gift pricing, generally around $100 for prospecting gifts; shipping is separate. The operator aims for 30–50% net margin.

acquisition_channels.details: The guest launched with a LinkedIn post; friends and her husband reshared it, and clients' LinkedIn posts brought inbound attention.
She says her clients came through referrals and word of mouth; an early sales contact introduced her to other representatives.
She tried Instagram ads, but says they did not take off.
Networking and being available to answer business questions are part of her stated approach.

ideas.delivery: The founder consults the company about the recipient, researches preferences, sources products from wholesale sites or vendors, presents gift options, personalizes items, writes a card, assembles and protects the gift, then ships using the client's or her negotiated carrier rates. Proposals are done at home and fulfillment at a warehouse.

prices: About $100 per prospecting gift; shipping extra
$75 for one gift build excluding mugs

ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR applies to recipient names, preferences and delivery addresses used for curation and shipping; minimize and secure that data. Corporate clients and recipients may have gift policies, and the UK Bribery Act may be relevant to gifts intended to influence business decisions. No subscription or employment-agency model is described.
